defaults.title: Function defaults
defaults.explainer: What a0 answers with when a request names no specific member. A request that names a member goes to that member.

say.starting: Starting… This usually takes under a minute. Nothing for you to do.

say.running_always_on: Running. Reserved for this engine; nothing can push it out.

notice.disabled: {{name}} is disabled: unloaded, and its slot is free.
notice.added_always_on: {{name}} added. It is always on, in slot {{slot}}.
notice.added_on_demand: {{name}} added. It loads the first time it is used.
notice.stopping: {{name}} is stopping. Its slot frees when it finishes.
notice.stopping_slot: {{slot}} is stopping. It frees when the member finishes.

standby.title: On standby
standby.disabled_catalog: Disabled as an engine. This model loads into the LLM slots on demand, as any model does.
standby.disabled_service: Disabled. Not loaded, and nothing uses it until you enable it.

explainer_toggle: What do Always on, On demand and Disabled mean?
behavior_explainer: Always on: a slot is reserved for it. It starts with the server, restarts by itself if it stops, and nothing can push it out. On demand: it loads on first use and is unloaded after it has been idle for a while, but only if the space is needed. Disabled: unloaded and its slot is free; it stays registered.
